edits.before: - Irelia Flawless Duet (Stun): matchup-defining — Her stun setup — dodge it and the dive falls apart. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Terrashape (element swap) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Irelia Flawless Duet (Stun): 16s at rank 1 — her only setup; dodge it and the dive falls apart. - Her W Defiant Dance is 20s early — trade the moment she burns it. - Your W is 7s, your R 120s: spend the ult only on the fight that ends the lane.
